einzeiler: Bestselling author Harlan Coben discusses his writing process, plot twists and new memoir.
kurzfassung: The hosts welcome bestselling author Harlan Coben to discuss his career, his writing routine, and his memoir Plot Twist. Coben shares insights into his early reading memories, his unorthodox methods regarding research, and the realities of getting his novels adapted for television internationally. The conversation also covers his collaboration with Reese Witherspoon and his approach to crafting suspenseful endings.
stichpunkte: Harlan Coben discusses his childhood reading experiences, highlighting books like Are You My Mother and Charlie and the Chocolate Factory as early influences.
He shares his path from playing basketball at Amherst College to writing his first novel while working in Spain.
Coben explains his firm stance against conducting extensive research for contemporary thrillers, preferring imagination and jargon over tedious fact-finding.
He talks about his memoir and writing guide, Plot Twist, which explores the intersections of his personal life and his fiction.
The discussion covers his successful television adaptations across the globe, including shows set in the UK, France, and Poland.
Coben details his co-writing experience with Reese Witherspoon on their joint project, emphasizing strict ground rules for the collaboration.
He shares his philosophy on plot twists, endings, and why he always knows the conclusion of a story before he begins writing.

clips.text: The guest singles out a classic children's picture book about an abandoned baby animal searching for its mother as the most terrifying story he encountered growing up.
The guest describes the initial pitch meeting with a famous actress turned producer, noting how quickly they fell into a creative rhythm and agreed to embark on a joint project.

clips.hook: Being the Jerry Lewis of crime fiction
clips.text: The author reveals that France is his largest market per capita, playfully comparing his massive overseas popularity to a famous American comedian beloved by French audiences.

clips.hook: Hollywood adaptations versus the original book
clips.text: The guest dismisses complaints about film and television adaptations altering original storylines by quoting a legendary writer who pointed out that the books remain safely untouched on shelves.

beschreibung:
Harlan Coben joins Books, Beach, & Beyond this week for such an entertaining conversation about reading and writing. Harlan is a #1 best-selling author and one of the world’s leading storytellers, and one of Tim's auto-buy authors. His thirty-eight suspense novels are published in forty six languages and have been number one bestsellers in more than a dozen countries. Your hosts talk with him about his new memoir Plot Twist along with topics like point of view, Harlan’s take on research, favorite endings in books and penning great plot twists, writing with Reese Witherspoon, and all his book to screen adaptations. The episode is filled with incredible writing tips and takeaways from a singular writing life.
